description: 北九州市 「準用河川改修事業」箇所一覧 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 本市で行っている準用河川改修事業実施箇所をまとめた一覧です。 ※準用河川改修事業：準用河川（24河川）のうち、浸水被害の発生の可能性が高い河川について、改修を行うものです。 ※準用河川：一、二級河川以外の河川で、市民生活と密接な関係にある河川等を市長が指定し管理を行っている河川. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are リスト. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
